summary: The change prevents an uploaded Codex window from being inflated by the subscription fallback and adds the requested regression assertion.

evidence: src/models/metadata.ts:221-234 disables the Codex subscription hint when the uploaded record declares a positive window, preventing it from widening resolvedWindow or declaredMaxWindow.
tests/model-metadata.test.ts:127-135 covers the 400000/400000 uploaded record with narrower 300000/300000 enrichment and asserts max_context_window_tokens remains 400000.
